item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya wants to find the volume of an irregularly shaped stone she found near the river. She has a measuring cylinder partially filled with water.

How should she find the volume of the stone?

options.A: Use the formula volume = length × width × height, treating the stone as a cuboid.
options.B: Lower the stone into the water and subtract the initial water reading from the final water reading.
options.C: Weigh the stone on a balance, since the mass is equal to the volume.
options.D: Read the water level in the cylinder before putting the stone in.
